 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Barcelona produced a blistering attacking display at the Spotify Camp Nou, overwhelming Alavés 6-1 in fixture number 11 of LaLiga EA Sports 26/27. The hosts were in control from the outset, and Raphinha opened the scoring after just eight minutes before Fermín López added a second midway through the first half.
 The first 45 minutes were entirely one-sided, with Barcelona stretching the advantage through a second Raphinha goal on 41 minutes and a Lamine Yamal strike in added time before the break. By half-time, the Catalans were four goals clear, having turned dominance in possession into a ruthless finishing edge.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The pattern continued after the restart, and Lamine Yamal completed his brace on 64 minutes after a VAR review confirmed the goal. Barcelona's attacking momentum did not stop there, with Anthony Gordon adding a sixth in the 81st minute after a through ball from Rodri.
 Alavés managed a late consolation through Mariano Díaz on 84 minutes, but it did little to alter the story of a match defined by Barcelona's control. The home side finished with 77% possession, 13 shots and seven on target, underlining a comprehensive victory built on pace, precision and sustained pressure.
